EXPO AGREEMENT 
 This Expo Agreement ( “Agreement”) is entered into at ________________ this ___ day of __________, 20 21. 
 BETWEEN 
 Zameen Media (Pvt) Limited , trading as Zameen.com, a company incorporated under the laws of Pakistan with its registered Head Office at 94-B/I, Pearl One, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore, Pakistan, acting through its duly authorised representative Mr./Ms. _____ __________________________ (“ Zameen ”), which expression shall, where the context admits, mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns . 
 AND 
 ____________________________________ __________________ _______ _ , a registered ____________________ ________________________________ _______ _ with its office at __________________________________________________________ __ , represented by ________ ________________________________________ ____ _ (the “Exhibitor” ), which expression shall, where the context admits, mean his/her representative or authorised personnel. 
 (Each referred to as a ‘ Party’ and collectively as ‘ Parties’ ) 
 WHEREAS 
 
 Zameen is organizing t he Pakistan Property Show by Zameen.com , a property expo, on November, 26 &amp; 27 , 2021 (the “ Expo ” or “Event” ) at the Dubai World Trade Centre, Dubai, United Arab Emirates (the “Event Facility” ); 
 
 The Exhibitor desires to participate in the Event by exhibiting its products or services; and 
 
 The Exhibitor has requested and Zameen has accepted the Exhibitor’s request to book a n E xhibition P ackage at the Event, and Exhibitor has confirmed the booking on the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement. 
 
 Now, therefore, both parties hereby fully agree as follows: 
 
 DEFINITION AND INTERPRETATION 
 This Agreement, along with the Expo Booking Form (“ Booking Form ”) attached herewith and the Pakistan Property Show terms stated on Zameen’s website at https://www.zameen.com/ppsterms.html (“ Dubai Expo Terms ”) and General Terms and Conditions available at https://www.zameen.com/terms.html (“ General Terms ”), constitute the entire agreement between the P arties. This Agreement supersedes all previous understanding, arrangements and/or agreements, whether oral or written, in relation to the subject matter hereof. 
 Capitalised terms used and not otherwise defined herein shall have the meaning given to them in the Dubai Expo Terms and the General Terms. Any terms used in this Agreement in the singular, where the context so permits, shall be deemed to include the plural and vice versa. 
 BOOKING AND PAYMENT 
 The Exhibitor shall select a package which shall include , inter alia , stall space at the Event in line with the floor plan presented by Zameen (the “ Floor Plan ”) , stall design ( if applicable ) , branding package and travel/accommodation specifications ( “Exhibition Package” ) at the time of signing of this Agreement . Exhibitor’s select ed Exhibition Package (“ Selected Package ”) shall be duly recorded in the Booking Form attached with this Agreement . If the Selected Package includes a customised stall, the Exhibitor shall be required to select a design , at least sixty (60) calendar days prior to the Event, from a portfolio presented by Zameen , which selection shall also be duly recorded in the Booking Form . The Exhibitor is advised to make their selection carefully as the selection cannot be modified by the Exhibitor at a later time and , except as indicated in Clause 10.1 , no refund shall be provided to the Exhibitor . 
 
 The Exhibitor must study the Event floor plan provided by Zameen in detail and assess stall location and dimensions at the time of signing of this Agreement. Once the Exhibitor has selected a stall and its location, as duly recorded in the Booking Form, no further changes shall be made to the Selected Package without prior written consent from Zameen , and Zameen shall bear no responsibility for the actual presentation of the selected stall at the Event Facility . 
 
 Zameen reserves the right to modify any Selected Package, the floor plan of the Even t, or the Event Facility entirely, at its sole discretion exercised within reason, and without prior notice to the Exhibitor . 
 
 The total price of the Selected P ackage is Rs. ___________________ ______ ____/- (Rupees _____________________________________________________ __ _ _____ ___ _____ only) (“ Total Consideration ”). Total Consideration is net of all taxes and/or withholdings applicable thereon, and the payment of all such taxes and/or withholdings shall be the sole responsibility of the Exhibitor. 
 
 At the time of signing of this Agreement, the Exhibitor shall pay to Zameen a minimum of seventy-five percent ( 75% ) of the Total Consideration ( “Initial Payment ”) , and the remaining twenty-five percent ( 25% ) of the Total Consideration (“ Remaining Payment ”) shall be paid by the Exhibitor no less than sixty ( 60 ) days prior to the Event. In case this Agreement is being signed within sixty ( 60 ) days or less of the Event, one hundred percent ( 100% ) of the Total Consideration shall be paid at the time of signing of this Agreement. Any Initial Payment made by Exhibitor shall be duly noted in the Booking Form attached hereto. All payments under this Agreement made via bank draft or crossed cheque shall be in favour of “ Zameen Media (Pvt) Limited ”. 
 
 If the Exhibitor fails to comply with the aforementioned payment schedule, or if any cheque provided by Exhibitor is dishonoured, any payment made against the Total Consideration and the Selected Package booked shall be forfeited by the Exhibitor. 
 
 All bookings shall be made on a first-come, first-served basis. The Exhibitor shall not transfer, sublet or share its assigned stall space, or any portion thereof, without prior written consent from Zameen. 
 
 
 
 STALL FABRICATION AND CUSTOMISATION 
 
 In the event that Exhibitor’s Selected Package does not include a fabricated stall, a shell scheme stall of dimensions specified in the Floor Plan shall be provided to the Exhibitor, along with one (1) glass round table, two ( 2 ) chairs and one (1) exhibition counter for every nine square meters (9 sq m t ) of stall space. 
 
 In case shell scheme is provided by Zameen in accordance with Clause 3.1 above, the branding and artwork of the shell scheme shall be the sole responsibility of the Exhibitor. 
 For the branding of the shell scheme, the Exhibitor shall only be permitted to use Zameen’s pre-approved vendor(s) and the Exhibitor shall not employ any other vendor(s) for the branding of the shell scheme at the Event Facility. However, Zameen shall not be liable for any delay, failure or error on the part of any vendor. In the event of any damage to the shell scheme due to non-compliance of the Exhibitor with this Clause 3.2, the Exhibitor shall be liable to pay all damages and losses suffered by Zameen. 
 
 If the Selected Package includes a fabricated stall, the Exhibitor may choose a fabrication design of their preference from the options provided to the Exhibitor by Zameen. In case of a fabricated stall, stall fabrication and design shall be prepared exclusively by Zameen’s pre-approved vendor(s) and the Exhibitor shall not employ any other vendor(s) to build and/or design stalls at the Event Facility. 
 
 In case of a fabricated stall, all artwork to be printed for the stall shall be provided by the Exhibitor to Zameen no later than forty-five ( 45 ) days prior to the date of the Event. Any delay or failure on the part of the Exhibitor to provide said artwork may result in a bare stall at the Event, for which Zameen shall bear no responsibility and provide no refund. In case this Agreement is being signed within forty-five ( 45 ) days of the Event or less, the Exhibitor shall provide the artwork at the time of signing of this Agreement , however , which shall not be less than twenty (20) days prior to the date of the E vent . 
 
 Zameen shall make every effort, within reason, to ensure that stall fabrication and design by the vendor(s) meets the specifications of Exhibitor’s Selected Package. However, Zameen shall not be liable for any delay, failure or error on the part of any vendor in the preparation and delivery of stall fabrication , design and/or artwork printing . 
 
 BRANDING AND MARKETING 
 
 Exhibitor undertakes and agrees to follow the Branding Guidelines for the Expo provided in the Selected Package and the Exhibitor Manual shared by Zameen with the Exhibitor. 
 
 Zameen reserves the right to remove, confiscate or relocate , without prior notice to the Exhibitor, any of the Exhibitor’s branding and/or marketing material at Zameen’s sole discretion where such material is inappropriate, does not conform to the terms of this Agreement, the Dubai Expo Terms, Branding Guidelines, Exhibitor Manual, General Terms and/or as stated in the Selected Package. The Exhibitor shall be fully responsible for any and all administrative costs incurred by Zameen and for any loss or damage ( s ) whether direct or indirect or consequential for and/or during such removal, confiscation and/or relocation. 
 
 
 RIGHTS OF ADMISSION 
 
 Rights of admission at the Event shall be solely reserved by Zameen. The Exhibitor, their representatives, affiliates, team members and/or guests may be denied entry to the Event or asked to leave the Event solely at Zameen’s discretion. 
 
 EXHIBITOR GUIDELINES 
 
 The Event Facility shall be made available to the Exhibitor for viewing one (01) day before the start of the Event , i.e., 25 th of November , 2021 . 
 
 The Exhibitor shall be responsible for keeping aisles near and /or around , adjacent and/or connected with its exhibit free of congestion caused by demonstrations, distribution of literature, obstructive branding material, or any other activities. 
 
 The Exhibitor is strictly prohibited from installing personal sound systems or use balloons at or near its stall ( s ) . Zameen reserves the right to disconnect, remove and confiscate any such item (s) and bill the offending Exhibitor for any administrative costs incurred by Zameen and for any loss or damage (s) whether direct or indirect or consequential for and/or during such disconnection, removal and/or confiscation. 
 
 The Exhibitor undertakes and represents that the Exhibitor and/or Exhibitor’s team member(s) shall not perform any of the Prohibited Activities, as provided in the Dubai Expo Terms and/or the General Terms and Conditions . Failure to comply with those may result in the Exhibitor and/or team members or any other representatives being removed from the Event and/or Event Facility. 
 
 The Exhibitor shall be solely responsible for any loss or damage whether direct , indirect or consequential caused to the Event and/or Event Facility by the Exhibitor and/or the Exhibitor’s team member(s) , officers, representatives, employees or agents . 
 
 TRAVEL AND ACCOMMODATION 
 
 Zameen shall arrange for a round-trip for the Exhibitor and/or their team member(s), as specified in the Selected Package, to travel from Pakistan to United Arab Emirates (UAE) and back, and shall make all travel and lodging arrangements in accordance with the Selected Package purchased by the Exhibitor, subject to visa approvals. 
 
 All travel and accommodation of the Exhibitor and/or their team shall be at the Exhibitor’s own risk and strictly in accordance with the Selected Package. 
 
 Zameen shall be the final authority on the selection of airline(s) and accommodation venue(s) for the purpose of this Agreement. All accommodation s shall be on a twin-sharing basis and room assignments shall be final and non-negotiable. 
 
 Provision of all valid travel document s for the Exhibitor and/or their team members shall be the sole responsibility of the Exhibitor. All necessary document s for travel and visa arrangements, shall be provided by the Exhibitor to Zameen at least sixty ( 60 ) days prior to the date of Event . 
 
 If this Agreement is being signed within the sixty- day period in Clause 7.4 above, the Exhibitor shall provide the aforementioned document s at the time of the signing of this Agreement , however , this shall not be less than thirty (30) days prior to the date of event . 
 
 Exhibitor shall ensure timely submission of all valid travel document s , including but not limited to passport(s) with at least six (6) months’ validity from the date of travel for each traveller. Zameen shall not be responsible and no refund shall be provided in case the Exhibitor or their team members are unable to travel to the Event as a result of delay in submission , non-submission or submission of invalid/expired travel document s by the Exhibitor. Zameen shall not be responsible for unavailability of flights and/or accommodation in the event of late submission of document s or submission of invalid document s by of the Exhibitor and/or the Exhibitor’s team member(s). 
 
 In the event that the Exhibitor and/or any of their team members are denied entry into the UAE for any reason whatsoever, there shall be no refund or cancellation of the Selected Package purchased by the Exhibitor. The Exhibitor may nominate a replacement or replacements as applicable, and Zameen shall make all reasonable efforts to arrange for their travel and accommodation, but does not guarantee such availability. In such an event, the Exhibitor shall pay any extra charges for th e service as and when billed by Zameen in relation thereto. 
 
 In the event that the Exhibitor cancels their travel and/or accommodation after execution of this Agreement , the Exhibitor shall not be entitled to any refund whatsoever . 
 
 The Exhibitor shall be solely responsible and liable for any loss or damage caused to the accommodation venue(s), either directly or indirectly or consequential , by the Exhibitor and/or the Exhibitor’s team member(s) . 
 
 The Exhibitor shall be solely responsible for compliance with the laws and regulations of the United Arab Emirates by the Exhibitor and/or Exhibitor’s team member(s) for the duration of their stay in the United Arab Emirates . 
 
 LIMITATION OF LIABILITY, WARRANTIES AND INDEMNIFICATION 
 
 Zameen shall not be liable for any direct or indirect loss, consequential loss, loss of profits, revenue, data or goodwill howsoever arising suffered by the Exhibitor arising in any way in connection with this Agreement or for any liability of the Exhibitor to any third party. 
 
 Zameen shall not be liable for any interruption to the Expo, whether intentional or otherwise. 
 
 Zameen shall not be liable for any failure in respect of its obligations hereunder which result , directly or indirectly , from failure and/ or interruption in services provided by third parties. 
 Zameen shall not be responsible for making and, does not guarantee that, the Event a success, generation of any leads or business opportunities or for the number of visitors, potential customers or clients at the Event. 
 Notwithstanding anything contained in this Agreement , Zameen's maximum aggregate liability to the Exhibitor under or in connection with this Agreement in respect of any direct loss (or any other loss to the extent that such loss is not excluded by other clauses in this Agreement) , whether such claim arises in contract or in tort , shall under no circumstances exceed a sum equal to the amount paid to Zameen by the Exhibitor in relation to which such claim arises. 
 The Exhibitor assumes full responsibility and liability for the actions of its employees, agents, independent contractors, and volunteers, and agrees to indemnify, hold harmless, and defend Zameen and each of its respective officers, directors, partners, agents, representatives, employees, and volunteers (collectively the “ Indemnified Parties ”) from and against all liabilities, obligations, claims, damages including injury, loss of life or loss of property, penalties, causes of action, costs and expenses (including without limitation, reasonable attorneys' fees and expenses) imposed upon or incurred by or asserted against any of the Indemnified Parties relating to the E xpo and/or performance of this Agreement . 
 
 FIRE, HEALTH AND SAFETY 
 
 The Exhibitor assumes all responsibility for compliance with all local city and state ordinance, regulations and laws, including but not limited to those pertaining to fire, health and safety. 
 
 Smoking or use of any contraband is strictly prohibited within the Event Facility at all times and failure to comply with this by the Exhibitor or their team member(s) or any other representative shall constitute a breach of this Agreement . 
 
 The Exhibitor shall follow all COVID-19 SOPs as notified by Zameen in the Exhibitor Manual and as per the UAE law and Dubai World Trade Centre rules and regulations. In case of any violation of such SOPs and rules, the Exhibitor shall be responsible for any fines and penalties. 
 
 The personal, health, travel, life and other similar insurances of the Exhibitor and their team member(s) shall be the sole responsibility of the Exhibitor. 
 
 TERMINATION 
 
 Zameen, at its sole discretion, has the right to cancel any booking or terminate this Agreement, without prior notice to the Exhibitor. In the event of such cancellation, subject to any exception in this Agreement , inter alia , Clauses 3. 4 , 7.6, 7.7, 7.8, 8.5 10.2 and 1 3 , Zameen’s liability shall be limited to refund of any amount paid by Exhibitor under this Agreement up till the date of termination of this Agreement provided that the maximum liability of Zameen under this Agreement shall never exceed the Total Consideration. 
 
 In case of any material breach of this Agreement by the Exhibitor, Zameen reserves the right to terminate this Agreement, in which case any payment(s) due to Zameen under this Agreement shall be paid by the Exhibitor within s ixty (60) calendar days of such termination. 
 
 INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY 
 
 Nothing contained in  this Agreement shall be deemed to constitute the grant of any license or other right to either Party, to or in respect of any work product, patent, trademark, confidential information, trade secret or other data or any other intellectual property of the other Party. 
 
 DISPUTE MANAGEMENT 
 
 Zameen shall have the exclusive right to resolve disputes that may arise from matters related to this Agreement, or those that occur at the Event Facility, and Zameen’s decision on any such dispute(s) shall be final. 
 
 FORCE MAJEURE 
 
 Zameen shall not be liable for postponement or cancellation of the Event or any other damages or disruption resulting from acts of God (including but not limited to fire, flood, earthquake, storm, hurricane or other natural disasters), war, invasion, act of foreign enemies, hostilities (regardless of whether war is declared), civil war, rebellion, revolution, insurrection, military or usurped power or confiscation, terrorist activities, nationalisation, foreign policy changes, government sanction, blockage, embargo, labour dispute, strike, pandemic, lock down, lockout or interruption or failure of electricity or telephone service, or failure of the Event venue administration to offer services as agreed. 
 
 GENERAL 
 
 The Parties intend that the relationship created between them by this Agreement shall be as independent contractors. This Agreement is not to be construed in any way as creating any partnership, principal-agent, master-servant, joint venture or other similar relationship between the Parties. 
 
 This Agreement and its annexures including the Dubai Expo Terms and General Terms and any other documents inferred herein constitute the entire agreement and understanding between the Parties with respect to the subject matter contained in this Agreement and supersedes and overrides all prior agreements, understandings and negotiations, written or oral, between the Parties.
